description: Bench trainer: SPDT toggle selects EXTEND or RETRACT lamp, each on its own fused 12 VDC branch.

components.description: Adjustable DC bench supply, set to 12.0 VDC, current limit ~0.2 A during setup
EXTEND branch feed from S1 UP
RETRACT branch feed from S1 DOWN

components.rating: 0.5 A fast-blow (rating TBD from fuse pack)
0.5 A fast-blow (rating TBD from fuse pack)

components.description: EXTEND indicator, 12 V LED lamp (stand-in for actuator extend)
RETRACT indicator, 12 V LED lamp (stand-in for actuator retract)

wires.nominal: +12 VDC when S1 UP and F1 intact
+12 VDC when S1 DOWN and F2 intact

test_points.tolerance_rule: Tolerance comes from the spec of the component being fed. If a test point has no tolerance listed, report the raw reading against nominal and say no tolerance is defined; do not judge pass/fail.

reading_classification.open: reading <= open_circuit_threshold_v where nominal_v is expected → red, points to an open in the circuit upstream of this test point
reading_classification.unexplained: any other reading → amber; say it doesn't match any fault in the job files, ask the tech to recheck meter leads and connection and re-enter; do not advance or flag a part
reading_classification.no_tolerance: test point has no tolerance listed → show raw reading vs nominal, say no tolerance is defined; no pass/fail

TS-1.tolerance_source: 12 V LED lamp, fused branch — ±10% acceptable (designer spec)
TS-1.note: 12 V at all times with PS1 on

faults.symptom: EXTEND does not work (L1 off with S1 UP); RETRACT works
faults.isolates: PS1, wire 1 and S1 COM are good because RETRACT works
suspects: wire 2b loose at TS-4 or F1
check_order: 12 V at TS-4 with S1 UP? If no: S1 UP contact or wire 2a.
12 V at F1:IN? If no: wire 2b open between TS-4 and F1.
12 V at F1:OUT? If no: F1 open — check fuse continuity with power off.
12 V at L1:+? If no: wire 2c open.
12 V at L1:+ but lamp off: L1 failed or L1 return (wire 0) open.

faults.symptom: RETRACT does not work (L2 off with S1 DOWN); EXTEND works
faults.isolates: PS1, wire 1 and S1 COM are good because EXTEND works
suspects: wire 3b loose at TS-5 or F2
check_order: 12 V at TS-5 with S1 DOWN? If no: S1 DOWN contact or wire 3a.
12 V at F2:IN? If no: wire 3b open between TS-5 and F2.
12 V at F2:OUT? If no: F2 open — check fuse continuity with power off.
12 V at L2:+? If no: wire 3c open.
12 V at L2:+ but lamp off: L2 failed or L2 return (wire 0) open.

suspects: PS1 off or in current limit
check_order: 12 V at TS-1? If no: PS1 or wire 1 from PS1.
12 V at S1 COM? If no: wire 1 between TS-1 and S1.
If 12 V present at a lamp + but both lamps off: check wire 0 at TS-2 and PS1 (-).
